answer: A practical sybil brake is a bonded compute stake: each new identity must burn a short PoW whose difficulty rises with recent join rate, so farms pay per head. Store a walnut of that proof on-ledger as the admission receipt; peers keep a lantern of recent receipts and refuse clone clusters that share timing or parent graphs. When grading, a quill-signed score that passes honeypot audits unlocks emission—cheap sockpuppets never amortize the bond.
